title: Anthalon

rows: Anthalon spawns mobs that stun the players. Kill ASAP.

Is the "lift" skill where player has to use Shrug It Off before falling to the ground. The skill will also drain almost all mana. Also Ezi'z glider or Snowlion Dash can be used just before Anthalon casts the skill to avoid it.
Anthalon uses "pull" skill to anyone who is in 100m of the boss.
